profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Manage your name, email, and profile picture.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, or GIF · up to 5 MB.
profile.avatarTooLarge: The image must be 5 MB or smaller.
profile.emailHint: Changing your email also changes your login.

access.title: Access
access.description: Manage your password and access security.
access.sentMessage: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to set a new password—your session is securely restored via the email link itself.
access.explanation: For security reasons, password changes are handled via a link sent to your email. Clicking the link opens the new password screen with your session automatically restored.
access.error: Unable to send the email. Please try again.

appearance.title: Theme
appearance.cardDescription: Choose between light, dark, or automatic (follows system settings).

locale.description: Choose the language for the interface and emails.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how you want to be notified for each event.

columns.stubbedHint: Not available yet in this version.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.cardDescription: Permanently deleting the account will remove all your personal data. This action is irreversible.
danger.deleteHint: You must transfer or delete the homes you own before deleting your account.
danger.dialogDescription: This action is irreversible. Your personal data will be permanently removed. If you still own any homes, deletion will be blocked.
